about: Benchmark questions. Each group holds questions that mean the same thing (paraphrases), so they should share one cached answer. type: repeat = cacheable question asked several ways; personal = personal or time-sensitive, should never be cached; one_off = asked once, some are look-alikes of a repeat group to catch wrong cache hits.
